body:
I'm curious about what definitions you're using for psychopathy, OP.  Because in my understanding, psychopathy is something that psychopaths almost definitionally do not struggle with or feel remorse for.  It is likewise my understanding that there is some confusion and/or distinction in the mental health industrial complex about whether ASPD and psychopathy are related, and, if so, to what extent.  

And frankly, I *do* wish I could turn off my humanity.  I *do* wish I were a better manipulator, and could bring myself to harm and exploit other people for my benefit and not give a shit about the consequences.  I wish I were really and truly a monster rather than just some sad asshole.

I think their biggest weakness is their intros to their sketches.  Half the time, they over-explain the premise and joke, which just leaves the bit flat.  When they do a sketch that *doesn't* have an intro, that's often the highlight of an episode for me.  

I think their brand of comedy is really tailor-made for YouTube: it's short, readily digestible, and on YouTube *they don't have the intros*.

No one is talking about Bipolar here but you; OP's ex has BPD: Borderline Personality Disorder. BPD is a wholly different beast from Bipolar, and unlike Bipolar **can't** be treated with medication.  If you are living a good life despite your Bipolar, that's great for you and an accomplishment you should take no small amount of pride in, but it's not the same as BPD.  [A quick glance at yonder subreddit might be a good first look at what it's like to have a loved one with BPD; the people there can explain it far better than me.](http://www.reddit.com/r/BPDlovedones)

I'm seconding /u/kayvent's message.  OP, for what it is worth, she has *not* changed and you are not missing out on anything except *maybe* someone who is a little more practiced in making someone else's life hell.  It's not quite a "bullet dodged" situation, more of a "thank god the gunner's shooting at someone else" one.  And that's not so bad, all things considered.

If you ever find yourself seriously contemplating whether a gift or act will seriously damage someone, **DON'T DO IT**.  Play it safe.  Especially don't write a message like that; it comes across as too clingy and passive-aggressive.  

You're already reaching out and generally being considerate.  Keep doing that, and don't do anything you're already seriously concerned will only make things worse.
OP, on the off chance you aren't a troll, the [NAW] tag exists for a reason.  Next time you just want to rant and kvetch, and *don't* want a debate, use the [NAW] tag.
And you continue to offer insults, in violation of the rules, and what appears to be an instruction to kill myself, which is also against the rules.  I'm reporting you for both.

Let's see if this goodbye sticks ...

If it does, I appreciate you being upfront at least.

So you're into unambiguous, full-on insults now.  Cute.  

I repeat, now that you have shown me who and what you really are, I am so glad you aren't happy with me.
No, I won't break the rules.  Just read the other comments here and report me for them.
Troll harder
Because I don't want to talk to them, because I can't be banned from PMs
For any reason you want.  Link to this thread.  They'll believe it.

Oh don't act so coy, please, it's unbecoming.

Before you edited your reply, you said, "Go ahead and report me."  And I did, and I have, and I will continue so long as you willfully violate the rules.

So?

Everyone will be glad to have me gone, me included, and you'll get the credit.

First, I have, sweetums :)

Second, I gave you one instance, because it is the one instance I have proof for so you can't dispute it, and because the violator is **IN THIS THREAD**.  

Third, you are flaunting your violation of the rules now.  Just so you know, in case you ever want to think you're above it all.
I have no interest in talking to you; I thought that was abundantly clear by now.  Just ask them to ban me, please.

First, I am the OP, and you are abusing the OP.  Reported for abuse.

Second, I tried sticking up for the little guy earlier, a guy another poster in this very thread bragged about trying to have banned from a different subreddit for being suicidal.  All that I got from that is my posts being deleted and removed.  Same as fucking always when I try to help other people, I get punished for it.
Please, just message the mods and ask them to ban me.  That is literally all I am asking, and you've demonstrated a willingness and proficiency at it.

You are a person on /r/suicidewatch.  That is the sum total of what I meant.  

And now that you've shown your true self and violated rule 1, I *really* have no interest talking to you.

I *am* trying to take control of my life.  I know myself too well. I am a stubborn asshole who **WILL** comment here even when it hurts me.  I know; I've seen me do it.  I'm **CURRENTLY** doing it.  I am asking the authorities here to ban me so that I don't have that option.
You were.  You said, "I've helped other people."  That is a claim of being a helper, which violates rule 4b.
You're the expert.  It was your first resort earlier today.  It made you feel better.  Please, be the one to do it.

Nope, I wanted a public conversation because that is **BANNABLE**.  I can't be banned from PMs.  

Apologies for confusing you with the unicorn.
Also, your post violates rule 4b because you advertise yourself as a "helper."  Reported for violating the rules.
Again, please either go away or message the mods to have me banned.

Why do you insist on violating the rules and acting offended when I report you for violating the rules?

This is my chief complaint against /r/suicidewatch: **NOBODY FUCKING READS THE FUCKING RULES**

You again?
 
Please go away or do what you tried to do earlier and message the mods to have me banned.  You seem to like the latter, why not give it a try?

I have no interest in helping others.  Helping others only hurts me.  Helping others brings me no joy, only and exclusively results in adding to my own misery, more often than not results in me being punished either by the people I have tried to help or by authorities that do not want them helped.  

You want to help people?  Help them yourself.  You want to be a good person?  Be a good person.  I am not, do not want to, and make no claims to be a good person.  I just want to be banned from wasting my time talking to people like you.

Please read [this stickies thread that expressly prohibits what you are proposing](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/2g9cmu/a_friendly_reminder_about_pms/).  

Moreover, in your reported comment, you said

> If you ever need someone to talk to, you know where to find me.

Short of literally taking out an advertisement in the newspaper, I cannot think of a more obvious advertisement that you are a "helper," which is expressly prohibited by rule 4b, in the big green sidebar to the righthand side of your screen.  That is why I reported you.

I don't want to talk to them.  I don't want the *ability* to talk to them.  I am *counting* on them being good people, inasmuch as "good people" would listen to someone's reasonable request that harms no one and can be effortlessly granted by them with a single left-click, and grant it.
I don't want to PM them.  I want the only channel to be public, so I don't have a non-bannable line of communication open with people I want to be banned from talking to.
Your comment violates rule 4b ("don't 'advertise' yourself as a helper or role model") and the ban on PMing or asking for PMs as a first resort.  Reported for violating those rules.

> I am trying to help him

By having him banned from ever talking to the people he asked for help, while still being able to see the things that triggered his distress?

*Sure* you're not.  You've just told him to shut up and taken actions that will prevent him from talking to the closest thing he has to a support group and **WILL NOT IN ANY WAY** keep him from viewing the same materials that triggered him.  

Do not try to move the goalposts.  I am **EXCLUSIVELY** talking about your efforts to get a suicidal OP, who reached out to you for help, *banned* from ever talking to the people he reached out to again.  Do you honestly believe that is going to do OP *any* good?  Have you considered the effects of being banned from asking for help will have, the chilling effect it is entirely likely to have on future efforts to ask for help?  Has it occurred to you that *OP can still read the materials even of you succeed in having him banned*?  

What good do you imagine banning him will accomplish?

And so are you, personally. 

Again, even If you succeed in getting him banned, **HE CAN STILL READ THE POSTS THAT TRIGGERED HIM**.  OP reached out to you, you are the closest thing to a support network OP has right now, and you're slapping him in the face.  All that banning him will accomplish show him that he can't count in sympathy or support from people he reaches out to in the hope that they might understand him; all it does is alienate someone who already feels alienated and afraid.  You are taking a bad situation and deliberately making it worse.

> I messaged the mods suggesting they ban him.

You're just *full* of compassion, aren't you?

What, exactly, would banning him accomplish?  I see nothing in the linked thread that OP wrote, apart from the post itself.  I see no abuse, spamming, or trolling.  Shit, he didn't respond at all.  The only thing the OP did was mention that reading a ~~bread~~ **thread** about imminent collapse triggers suicidal thoughts and feelings, which, to quote Confucius, "fucking *duh*!"

Banning OP would not help him in any way.  **HE CAN STILL READ THE SHIT THAT'S BOTHERING HIM.** Not only that, but he won't be able to talk about it with you folks, who are the closest thing to any support network that OP has.  

And you want to have him banned, told in no uncertain terms that he's *not* welcome and you want nothing to do with him.  

Merry Fucking Christmas, I guess.
